title: Machine learning-based multi-omic analysis identifies CEP55, DLGAP5, and EZH2 as regulated cell death biomarkers linked to immunotherapy resistance in hepatocellular carcinoma.
authors: Azanbayeva, Dinara; Ali, Awais; Abdelkarem, Omneya; Touir, Gulnaz; Algazina, Togzhan
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习多组学分析筛选肝癌中调控性细胞死亡相关预后标志物，核心是基因表达与临床关联，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，仅涉及蛋白-蛋白互作与SNP结构模拟，与本课题TF-DNA互作无关。
abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) often exhibits limited responsiveness to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), largely due to an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME). Regulated cell death (RCD) pathways, including ferroptosis, necroptosis, and pyroptosis, possess immunogenic properties that may influence tumor-immune interactions and therapeutic responses. However, the prognostic significance of RCD-related genes and their relationship with immune suppression and anti-PD-1 resistance remain insufficiently understood. Two bulk RNA-seq datasets (GSE181947 and GSE248516) representing immunologically distinct HCC subtypes were analyzed to identify differentially expressed genes (DEGs). These were intersected with curated ferroptosis-, necroptosis-, and pyroptosis-related gene sets, yielding 36 differentially expressed RCD-related genes (DE-RCDRGs). Functional enrichment, protein-protein interaction (STRING and CytoHubba), and survival analyses (Kaplan-Meier Plotter, TCGA-LIHC) were performed to prioritize hub genes. Clinical correlations and epigenetic regulation were assessed using UALCAN. Expression validation was conducted across 24 liver cancer cell lines using Human Protein Atlas (HPA) RNA-seq data. Additionally, deleterious non-synonymous SNPs (nsSNPs) in prioritized genes were structurally characterized using integrative in silico modeling. Ten hub genes were identified, with CEP55, DLGAP5, and EZH2 emerging as key prognostic markers. These genes were significantly overexpressed in tumors, associated with advanced stage and poor differentiation, and showed aberrant DNA methylation. Functional enrichment linked them to oxidative stress response, mitotic regulation, and epigenetic control. Cell-line analysis showed CEP55 and DLGAP5 enrichment in SNU-series models, while EZH2 was highly expressed in HuH-6, Hep3B, and Huh7. Structural analysis further identified deleterious nsSNPs affecting critical functional domains. CEP55, DLGAP5, and EZH2 are identified as RCD-associated biomarkers linked to immune suppression and immunotherapy resistance in HCC.
abstract_zh: 肝细胞癌（HCC）通常对免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）表现出有限的响应性，这主要归因于免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境（TME）。受调控的细胞死亡（RCD）通路，包括铁死亡（ferroptosis）、坏死性凋亡（necroptosis）和焦亡（pyroptosis），具有免疫原性特性，可能影响肿瘤-免疫相互作用及治疗响应。然而，RCD相关基因的预后意义及其与免疫抑制和抗PD-1耐药性的关系仍未被充分理解。分析了两个代表免疫学上不同HCC亚型的批量RNA-seq数据集（GSE181947和GSE248516），以识别差异表达基因（DEGs）。这些基因与精选的铁死亡、坏死性凋亡和焦亡相关基因集取交集，得到36个差异表达的RCD相关基因（DE-RCDRGs）。进行了功能富集、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（STRING和CytoHubba）及生存分析（Kaplan-Meier Plotter、TCGA-LIHC），以优先筛选核心基因。使用UALCAN评估了临床相关性和表观遗传调控。利用人类蛋白质图谱（HPA）RNA-seq数据在24种肝癌细胞系中进行了表达验证。此外，使用整合性计算机模拟建模对优先基因中的有害非同义单核苷酸多态性（nsSNPs）进行了结构表征。鉴定出十个核心基因，其中CEP55、DLGAP5和EZH2成为关键预后标志物。这些基因在肿瘤中显著过表达，与晚期和低分化相关，并表现出异常的DNA甲基化。功能富集将其与氧化应激响应、有丝分裂调控和表观遗传控制联系起来。细胞系分析显示CEP55和DLGAP5在SNU系列模型中富集，而EZH2在HuH-6、Hep3B和Huh7中高表达。结构分析进一步识别出影响关键功能结构域的有害nsSNPs。CEP55、DLGAP5和EZH2被确定为与HCC中免疫抑制和免疫治疗耐药性相关的RCD相关生物标志物。
